data.one_liner: Flutter wrapper for the Telegram Mini Apps API with type-safe Dart classes.
data.what_it_does: Provides type-safe Dart classes and methods to access the Telegram Mini Apps JavaScript API. Handles underlying JS interop for UI control, event handling, cloud storage, and device sensors within Telegram.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application designed to run as a Telegram Mini App
You need to access Telegram Web App API features like theme colors, popups, and user data
avoid_when: You are building a standard mobile or web app outside the Telegram ecosystem
strengths: Strongly typed enums and classes for Telegram Web App API parameters and responses
Supports asynchronous operations and event handling through streams
weaknesses: Requires manual inclusion of the external Telegram web app script in index.html
Tightly coupled to the Telegram Mini Apps platform
data.setup_notes: Add the Telegram Mini Apps JavaScript script tag to your web/index.html file.
